user_actions: Register for the CRIS public interface at https://cris.txdot.gov ('Download interface data from Crash Reports for statistical purposes'; guide v29 p. 7-9). Log in at least every 30 days or the account is deleted.

Request Public Extract, format CSV, location filter County = DALLAS, crash date 01/01/2025-12/31/2025. Then the same for 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021 (one request per year; 5 years per TxDOT TSAP Table 6-1).
Optional second county: TRAVIS 2025 (to measure what Austin's open copy leaves out) and HARRIS 2025 (Houston has no open crash table).
Set an extract password; download each zip from the email link; unzip with 7-Zip or Keka into ~/.hermes/cache/scratch/states/tx/cris/<county>_<year>/ keeping every CSV including the lookup file.
Email TRF_CRASH@txdot.gov asking whether public-extract rows and maps made from them may be shown inside a paid product.
